content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question regarding temperature measurement at three locations, each about 3 or 4 meters from the CPU. I'm aware that longer wiring can impact sensor reliability, so I would prefer not to use PT100 sensors or similar devices that require an extension module. Instead, I want to use the built-in analog inputs provided on the base module. I am considering sensors that feature ADC conversion and could be integrated with my program. If you have any recommendations for such sensors or can provide a part number or datasheet for suitable options, I would appreciate it so I can order them directly from the manufacturer.
Thread closed due to duplicate post. The second post titled 'Question about pt100' is already published in the [product_name] - Hardware section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking to measure temperature at three locations that are several meters away from the CPU. Reliability concerns regarding long cables are noted, and the user prefers to use the built-in analog inputs of the base module rather than PT100 sensors and any required expansion modules. The user seeks compatible sensors with necessary datasheet and ordering details. The discussion was closed due to duplicate posting, with no further technical feedback shared.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to achieve reliable temperature readings using only the built-in analog inputs on the base module, without needing additional expansion modules, and is asking for suggestions and documentation for compatible sensors.
